title: Elite: Twin Gates of Overcharge
description: Elite remix of Twin Gates of Overcharge: the same story pressure becomes a sharper tactical problem, not a stat-inflated repeat.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards

objectives.primary: Hold the battle line through four enemy turns while the Gate pulse is measured. Elite remix: complete it while stabilizing a secondary solar seal.
optional: Stop every reinforcement trigger or defeat the reinforcement commander first

enemyWaves.entry: split flanks with one enemy already contesting an objective

boss.mechanic: changes start positions, suppresses one recovery lane, and forces objective timing

specialRules: Overcharge Law: standing on empowered tiles grants attack reach but increases incoming pressure.
Split Threat: two objectives resolve on opposite sides of the field.
Elite Remix: enemy AI prioritizes objectives and exposed support Titans.
Restricted Recovery: healing or recovery tiles deactivate after use.
victoryConditions: Hold the battle line through four enemy turns while the Gate pulse is measured.
Secondary solar seal stabilized before extraction

firstClear: Elite Aten Ra mission 13 codex shard

stars.three: Primary, secondary, and all optional objectives completed
